step1_analysis.description: An analog memory cell that samples an input current from a PMOS source during phase 1 and stores it on a capacitor via a diode-connected NMOS cascode. During phase 2, it subtracts the stored current from a new input current and steers the difference to summing nodes based on digital weights, performing a MAC operation for image processing.

paper_reference.title: CMOS Image Sensor With Mixed-Signal Processor Array

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VBIAS=1.2V, PMOS current is ~8uA. Power = 1.8V * 8uA = 14.4uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a typical bias current of 8uA for the PMOS source to keep all cascode transistors in saturation.

copy_error.description: Percentage error between the sampled current and the held current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Charge injection from switch XMP1 (Cgs ~ 12.5fF) onto C_hold (135fF) causes a small voltage step, leading to current error.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the switch size and hold capacitor. 135fF is explicitly reported in the paper.

settling_time.description: Time required for the memory cell to settle to 99% of its final value during the sample phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tau = C_hold / Gm = 135fF / 200uA/V = 0.67ns. 99% settling is ~4.6 * Tau = 3ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast settling due to small hold capacitor and moderate transconductance of the NMOS sink.

mac_output_current.description: The difference current steered to the output summing node during the evaluate phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_eval - I_hold. If VBIAS changes from 1.2V to 1.1V, PMOS current increases by ~5uA, which is steered to POSITIVE_SUM.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly depends on the applied input current difference during the evaluate phase.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption, current sampling accuracy, settling time, and MAC operation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Current MAC Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmm2=5u L_xmm2=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmcn=5u L_xmcn=0.5u
.param W_xmm3=5u L_xmm3=0.5u
.param W_xmcp=5u L_xmcp=0.5u
.param W_xmm1=5u L_xmm1=0.5u
.param W_xmr2=5u L_xmr2=0.5u
.param W_xmr1=5u L_xmr1=0.5u
.param W_xmp2=5u L_xmp2=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
V_VBIAS VBIAS 0 PWL(0 1.2 1u 1.2 1.05u 1.1 2u 1.1)
V_VCASP VCASP 0 0.9
V_VCASN VCASN 0 1.1
V_POS POSITIVE_SUM 0 0.9
V_NEG NEGATIVE_SUM 0 0.9
V_N3 N3 0 0

V_PHI1 PHI1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.1u 10n 10n 0.8u 2u)
V_PHI2 PHI2 0 0
V_WRC WR_C_PLUS 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1.1u 10n 10n 0.8u 2u)

C_hold N2 0 135f
.ic v(N2)=0

XMM2 N5 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmm2} w={W_xmm2}
XMP1 N0 PHI1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMCN NEGATIVE_SUM POSITIVE_SUM N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmcn} w={W_xmcn}
XMM3 N0 VCASN N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmm3} w={W_xmm3}
XMCP POSITIVE_SUM WR_C_PLUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmcp} w={W_xmcp}
XMM1 N1 N1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmm1} w={W_xmm1}
XMR2 N0 VCASP N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr2} w={W_xmr2}
XMR1 N4 VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr1} w={W_xmr1}
XMP2 N2 PHI2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmp2} w={W_xmp2}

.control
tran 1n 2u

* 1. Power Consumption
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=2u
let power_consumption = -avg_current * 1.8
print power_consumption

* 2. Sampled Current
meas tran I_pmos_sample find i(VVDD) at=0.8u
let I_in_sample = -I_pmos_sample
meas tran I_nmos_sample find i(VVSS) at=0.8u
print I_in_sample I_nmos_sample

* 3. Settling Time
meas tran V_N2_final find v(N2) at=0.9u
let V_N2_99 = V_N2_final * 0.99
meas tran settling_time trig v(PHI1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=$&V_N2_99 rise=1
print settling_time

* 4. Hold Current and Copy Error
meas tran I_nmos_hold find i(VVSS) at=1.2u
let copy_error_pct = abs(I_nmos_hold - I_nmos_sample) / I_nmos_sample * 100
print I_nmos_hold copy_error_pct

* 5. MAC Output Current (Evaluate Phase)
meas tran I_pmos_eval find i(VVDD) at=1.8u
let I_in_eval = -I_pmos_eval
meas tran I_pos_sum find i(V_POS) at=1.8u
let I_diff_expected = I_in_eval - I_nmos_hold
print I_in_eval I_pos_sum I_diff_expected

quit
.endc
